items.headline: Laura Rutledge shouts out her old crew during 'Nation on Location'
items.description: ESPN reporters preview the biggest Week 2 matchups from around the nation as former SEC Nation host Rutledge sends a special message to the team.

items.headline: SEC Nation describes how Ohio State vs. Texas could go
items.description: Paul Finebaum says this top-five matchup is a must-win for Steve Sarkisian while the rest of the SEC Nation crew explains how the Longhorns have to show up against the Buckeyes.

items.headline: SEC Now's keys for No. 4 Texas to take down No. 1 Ohio State
items.description: SEC Network's Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson break down where the Longhorns can improve their run game and minimize mistakes to take down an efficient Buckeyes squad.

items.headline: Texas students brave sweltering heat to be first in line for Ohio State game
items.description: The group in front of the growing line of students waiting to get in first to see the Longhorns' marquee Week 2 matchup has held its position since Thursday night.

items.headline: Tim Tebow: No. 1 Ohio State vs. No. 4 Texas won't come down to QBs
items.description: SEC Network's Tebow says the difference in the top-five matchup will be the players around the QBs, from the O-line to Texas transfers getting open for Arch Manning.

items.headline: Laura Rutledge explains why No. 4 Texas needs to beat No. 1 Ohio State
items.description: ESPN's Rutledge joins SEC This Morning to break down what's at stake for the Longhorns in their showdown with the top-ranked Buckeyes.
